The selected fast terrestrial carbon graph retains three reservoir boxes and four directed transfers: atmospheric uptake by plants, plant respiration to atmosphere, litterfall to dead organic/soil, and decomposition/soil respiration back to atmosphere. Three atmosphere circles remain a learned carbon-dioxide category cue, not atom counts. The living plant keeps its two-leaf/stem cue; the dead leaf, vein and soil line remain in the third reservoir.
